title: GVD: Governed Versioning and Deduplication for Document Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2609.17696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document repositories evolve continuously. Guidelines and policies are revised, superseded, and re-uploaded, so the same content recurs in different wording and newer versions refine or contradict earlier ones. These inconsistencies belong to the growing collection rather than to any single document, yet existing work treats versioning, duplicate detection, and contradiction detection as isolated pairwise tasks and stops once a pair is labeled. We present GVD (Governed Versioning and Deduplication), a framework that unifies cross-document version linking with rule-level conflict resolution under an auditable update policy. Incoming documents are assigned to version families through bidirectional rule alignment, and their rules are compared against the family memory to identify duplicates, contradictions, asymmetric refinements, and new knowledge, with Counterfactual Span Probing (CSP) resolving related pairs that inference misclassifies

translated_title: GVD：面向文档库的受管版本管理与去重
translated_abstract: 文档库在持续演进。指南和政策不断被修订、取代和重新上传，因此相同内容会以不同的措辞反复出现，而新版本会细化或与早期版本相矛盾。这些不一致性属于不断增长的文档集合本身，而非任何单一文档，然而现有工作将版本管理、重复检测和矛盾检测视为孤立的成对任务，且在完成一对文档的标注后便停止。我们提出了GVD（受管版本管理与去重），这是一个在可审计的更新策略下，将跨文档版本链接与规则级冲突解决统一起来的框架。新传入的文档通过双向规则对齐被分配到版本族中，其规则会与版本族记忆进行比较，以识别重复项、矛盾、非对称细化和新知识，并通过反事实跨度探测（CSP）来纠正推理中被误分类的相关文档对。
tldr: GVD框架在可审计的更新策略下统一了跨文档版本链接与规则级冲突解决，通过双向规则对齐和反事实跨度探测，识别文档库中的重复、矛盾、非对称细化和新知识。
en_tdlr: GVD unifies cross-document version linking with rule-level conflict resolution under an auditable update policy, using bidirectional rule alignment and Counterfactual Span Probing to identify duplicates, contradictions, asymmetric refinements, and new knowledge in document repositories.
